blind.details: There is no text, labels, or watermarks. The subject is a single cohesive sculpted object, appearing as a trophy, monument, or fantasy game asset. It consists of three primary connected parts: a central broadsword pointing downwards, a large heater-style shield behind it, and a multi-tiered stone or metallic pedestal below. The sword has a diamond-shaped pommel set with a faceted blue gem, a cylindrical handle wrapped in blue leather, a flared crossguard set with another blue gem, and a thick, stylized double-edged blade. The shield features a deep royal blue field framed by thick beveled grey borders with dull-gold edges, flanked inside by relief-sculpted silver-grey wings. The tiered base has matching grey and gold-beveled stone steps, recessed blue side panels, and a central front-facing blue plaque with a raised gold diamond emblem. The entire object is depicted whole without any cropping. The background is completely solid, uniform white with no floor, shadows, or surrounding elements.
